title: VUS - The English Center
description: teachenglish.vus.edu.vn zoominfo.com/c/vus---the-english-center/1308758011 VUS (Vietnam USA Society English Centers) (founded 1997, Ho Chi Minh City) is Vietnam's largest English-language school chain — 70+ centers nationwide with 7,000+ staff, 600+ foreign teachers and 250,000+ students a year (3 million cumulative). It runs Cambridge, IELTS (IDP), TOEFL/TOEIC (ETS) and Oxford University Press programs plus a joint degree track with the University of Saint Mary (USA), holding Guinness World Record and Vietnam Record awards. The teachenglish.vus.edu.vn portal recruits TEFL/TESOL/CELTA-qualified native-speaking teachers (~$20–35/hr) with sponsored work visas, housing help, flights and a formal career ladder (Teacher → Head Teacher).
